map.🌡️ 贮藏环境通用标准: 🌡️ General standards for the storage environment
map.通过日晒、摊晾、烘干等方法降低药材含水量。含水量一般控制在：根茎类11-13%，: Reduce the moisture content of herbs by sun drying, air drying or oven drying. Moisture content is generally controlled at: roots and rhizomes 11-13%, fruits 8-10%, flowers and leaves 7-9%.
map.将贵重药材或易虫蛀药材置于冷库（2-8°C）保存，可防虫防霉，适用于人参、西洋参: Store valuable or insect-prone herbs in a cold store (2-8 C) to prevent insects and mold; suitable for ginseng, American ginseng, deer antler and bird's nest.
map.将干燥药材装入密封容器中，隔绝空气中的水分和微生物。可配合干燥剂（硅胶）使用。: Place dried herbs in sealed containers, isolating them from moisture and microorganisms in the air. Can be used together with desiccants (silica gel).
map.利用两种药材的特殊气味互相防虫。如：牡丹皮与泽泻同贮防虫；花椒与动物类药材同贮防: Use the special odors of two herbs to protect each other from insects. For example moutan bark with alisma to prevent insects; prickly ash with animal materials to prevent insects; camphor with Chinese herbs to repel insects.
map.温度25-35°C、湿度>70%时易发，见于含淀粉、蛋白质丰富的药材: Likely at 25-35 C and humidity above 70%, common in herbs rich in starch and protein
map.湿度>75%、温度25-35°C时易发，见于含糖、粘液质多的药材: Likely at humidity above 75% and 25-35 C, common in herbs rich in sugar and mucilage
map.含挥发油、脂肪油的药材在高温下氧化变质，如杏仁、桃仁、当归: Herbs containing volatile oils or fatty oils oxidize at high temperature, such as apricot kernel, peach kernel and angelica
map.花叶类受光照和高温影响褪色，如红花、菊花: Flowers and leaves fade under light and high temperature, such as safflower and chrysanthemum
map.芳香性药材在高温下挥发油散失，如薄荷、藿香: Aromatic herbs lose volatile oils at high temperature, such as mint and patchouli
map.📚 深度解析：中药贮藏（温/湿度/避光）条件: 📚 In-depth analysis: Chinese herb storage (temperature / humidity / light protection) conditions
map.党参/当归/黄芪/山药等含糖量高易虫蛀 → 阴凉库（≤20℃、RH45-75%）: Codonopsis, angelica, astragalus and chinese yam are high in sugar and easily insect-damaged, so store in a cool store (20 C or below, RH 45-75%); sealing plus lime desiccant plus regular fumigation is recommended (use aluminum phosphide with care).
map.薄荷/藿香/肉桂/丁香挥发性强 → 避光冷藏（2-10℃），分装小包避免反复开盖: Mint, patchouli, cinnamon and clove are highly volatile, so store protected from light and cold (2-10 C) in small packages to avoid repeated opening; for every 1 C above the temperature limit the volatile loss increases by 0.5-1%.
map.RH 过高怎么办？: What if RH is too high?
map.加石灰/氯化钙吸潮柜、密封、空调除湿；含脂溶性成分药材 RH>80% 易霉变/酸: Add a lime or calcium chloride desiccant cabinet, sealing and air conditioning dehumidification; herbs containing fat-soluble components mold or turn rancid when RH exceeds 80%; inspect every 3-7 days.
map.家用怎么存？: How should they be stored at home?
map.关键是密封、阴凉干燥、避光：用带密封圈的玻璃或食品级塑料罐分装，内置食品级干燥剂: The key is sealing, keeping cool and dry, and protecting from light: pack into glass or food-grade plastic containers with a sealing gasket, put in food-grade desiccants and keep in a cool place (below 20 C); valuable insect-prone herbs (such as cordyceps or ginseng) can be sealed and refrigerated (4 C), and after taking them out let them return to room temperature before opening to avoid condensation. Herbs containing volatile oils (mint, patchouli, amomum) should be sealed separately and not stored together with odor-absorbing herbs; check once a year around the plum rain season for mold or insects.
